summary: Comprehensive test suite covering all major requirements: Expand-MatrixAxes, exclude/include rules, size validation, strategy assembly, config validation, CLI entry point, workflow structure, and end-to-end pipeline via act. Well-organized with 48+ test cases across unit, structure, and integration layers. Clear TDD progression shown in Describe blocks. Good separation of concerns (MatrixGenerator.Tests.ps1, Workflow.Tests.ps1, ActPipeline.Tests.ps1). Strengths: thorough function-level testing, proper error scenario coverage, clever test design (helper functions, fixture setup, BeforeAll/BeforeEach patterns), produces required act-result.txt artifact. Weaknesses: only 2 act test cases for a matrix generator (case1: basic 2x2, case2: complex with flags/exclude/include) limits edge-case coverage in real CI; fixture file contents not verifiable from provided test code; no performance/stress testing; minor exotic edge cases (unicode, extremely large matrices) untested. The act test suite's reliance on Docker and 1-2 minute execution time per case may add friction to development. Would reliably catch regressions in core matrix generation logic but might miss subtle bugs in unexplored combinations.
